params.name: offset
params.description: An integer that designates the offset at which to begin returning results. Defaults to 0.

params.name: include
params.description: Request that the response include the total count by specifying `include=["total_count"]`.

params.name: date_created
params.description: Filter by date created. Accepted formats are ISO-8601 date or datetime, e.g. `{ "gt": "2012-01-01", "lt": "2012-01-31T12:34:56Z" }` where `gt` is >, `lt` is <, `gte` is e, and `lte` is d.

params.name: date_modified
params.description: Filter by date modified. Accepted formats are ISO-8601 date or datetime, e.g. `{ "gt": "2012-01-01", "lt": "2012-01-31T12:34:56Z" }` where `gt` is >, `lt` is <, `gte` is e, and `lte` is d.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sorts items by ascending or descending dates. Use either `date_created` or `date_modified`, not both.

items.docs: Returns a list of your billing_groups. The billing_groups are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recently created billing_groups appearing first.
Creates a new billing_group with the provided properties.
